motivation: The exposed joint-v2 compositional failure motivates testing size separately from a shape/color visual inductive bias.

training.initialization: Same existing speech-CNN features; all other parameters initialized from one fixed seed; all trainable
training.data: Exactly the existing 2048 training scenes, with independently resampled speech as in joint-v2; all held word/color tuples excluded

development: New ID and compositional panels paired with existing dev recordings; select checkpoint by equal mean of six-family normalized NLL across ID and compositional slices
calibration: New ID and compositional panels paired with existing calibration recordings; scalar temperature fitted after nomination

confirmation.audio: All 117 remaining recordings from 80 speakers absent from every previous baseline and joint manifest
confirmation.panels: One new ID panel and one new compositional panel per recording; deterministic independent seeds
confirmation.scope: Same-gap confirmation on fresh speakers/images. The held tuple identities were exposed in joint-v2, and are now in development; this is NOT a new-gap generalization claim.
confirmation.opening: Only after all three checkpoints and the development nomination are committed
confirmation.evaluation: Evaluate all three predeclared conditions once, retain every result
confirmation.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over speakers, 2000 resamples, fixed seed 20260925; describes checkpoints, not training-seed variance

comparison: Optimizer updates and sampled requests are matched, not FLOPs or time. Report parameters and actual synchronized training time separately. A time-capped incomplete run is retained and labelled unmatched.
frozen_reference: Evaluate existing served joint-full-v2 on the same fresh confirmation rows after nomination, with its existing calibration temperature. It is not a new training or selection candidate.
promotion: No automatic serving default promotion. A candidate needs positive compositional paired interval and no more than one percentage point ID regression against the matched small baseline; scope remains generated panels.
factorized_prior: Fixed pixel-only dark-ink map (max RGB intensity <= 0.2 gives 1, >= 0.4 gives 0, linear between), shape CNN and separate spatially pooled RGB branch, concatenated into each tile token. Renderer-specific prior, not general segmentation and not a paper reproduction.
limits: No paid APIs or new large downloads
No claim to reproduce Jev or recursive self-improvement
